auth.lead: Sign in with your organisation account to manage this platform.

form.errors: {count, plural, =0 {No errors} one {# error} other {# errors}}
form.enum: Value must be one of the allowed choices

approvals.lead: Every change to the project is a proposal here until an approver merges it.
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.author: Author
approvals.needsRole: The portal-approver role is required to approve or reject.
approvals.ownProposal: You cannot approve or reject your own proposal.
approvals.confirmPrompt: For red lane, type the resource name to confirm:

lane.greenHelp: Low risk: the change only adds, nothing in service is replaced.
lane.yellowHelp: Medium risk: an existing resource is changed in place.
lane.redHelp: High risk: a live resource is deleted or replaced; its name must be typed to confirm.

phase.draftHelp: Not proposed yet, saved locally only.
phase.pendingApprovalHelp: Waiting for an approver to approve or reject it.
phase.deployingHelp: Approved and merged; the reconciler is applying it.
phase.liveHelp: Applied and running as the manifest describes.
phase.errorHelp: The reconciler could not apply the change.
phase.driftedHelp: The cluster no longer matches the manifest in Git.
phase.mergedHelp: The merge request is merged into main.
phase.syncedHelp: The repository carries what the source publishes.
phase.outOfSyncHelp: The source has moved and the repository does not carry it yet.
phase.pausedHelp: Syncing is switched off until somebody resumes it.

summary.update: {fields, plural, =0 {Update {kind} "{name}"} one {Update {kind} "{name}" ({fields} field changed)} other {Update {kind} "{name}" ({fields} fields changed)}}

quota.exceeded: The project quota of {limit} Context Spaces is used up. Ask a platform administrator to raise it.

spaces.lead: The named collections of context data this project holds; every entity lives in exactly one.
spaces.title: Context Spaces
spaces.empty: This project has no Context Space yet.
spaces.addHint: Saving proposes a change; a space appears once the change is approved.

inside.noModel: This space names no data model, so its entity types are unknown.
inside.noTypes: The data model {model} defines no entity type.
inside.noEndpoint: no endpoint without a policy or with a public audience, so counts cannot be read
inside.noEntities: No entity of this type yet.
inside.noEndpoints: This space has no endpoint yet.
inside.noPolicies: This space has no policy yet.

endpoints.lead: Where a space is published: who may call it, in which representations, under which URL.
endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.empty: This project publishes no endpoint yet.
endpoints.addHint: Saving proposes a change; the endpoint answers once the change is approved.
endpoints.publicNotice: An endpoint with a public audience answers anonymous callers, and an anonymous caller may only read. Writes and subscriptions still need a login, whichever representations are enabled.

projection.title: Published attributes
projection.hint: An endpoint can narrow what the policy grants, never widen it. A hidden attribute is absent from every representation and from the published schema.
projection.none: Nothing is published under this type.
projection.unavailable: This endpoint publishes no schema yet; type an attribute name to hide it.
projection.notCompiled: The gateway does not compile this formalism; it is served once Model Tools commits it beside the source.

datasources.title: Data sources
datasources.lead: Where the city reads from: one connection per source, declared once and referenced by the pipelines that read it.
datasources.empty: This project has no data source yet.
datasources.secretHint: Credentials stay in the secret store. A form takes the name and the key of a reference, never the value itself.

dialog.mqtt: Subscribes to topics on a broker and hands every message to the pipeline that references it.
dialog.http: Polls a URL on the pipeline's own period.
dialog.websocket: Holds a socket open and reads the messages the server pushes.
dialog.gtfs-rt: Reads a GTFS-realtime feed; the protobuf is decoded before the pipeline sees it.

pipelines.lead: What brings data in: each pipeline reads a source, transforms it and writes through an endpoint.
pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.empty: This project has no pipeline yet.

class.residentHelp: Runs continuously in the project's Bento runner.
class.scheduledHelp: Runs as a Kubernetes CronJob and stops between runs.

metrics.unavailable: No numbers: the runner is not answering.

pipelines.pauseHint: Proposes a change that stops this pipeline.
pipelines.resumeHint: Proposes a change that starts this pipeline again.

dashboards.lead: Maps drawn from the endpoints of this project.
dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.empty: This project has no dashboard yet.
dashboards.mapUnavailable: The map needs WebGL, which this browser does not offer.
dashboards.layerBlocked: Not shown, because a public dashboard may only read public endpoints: {layers}

playground.title: Federation playground
playground.subtitle: Context spaces, their registrations and the traffic between them — drawn in your browser, with nothing asked of the server.
playground.noEvents: No answer yet. Press “Send a query”.
playground.entities: {count, plural, =0 {no entities} one {# entity} other {# entities}}
playground.noLinks: This space registers no context source and is registered by none.

accounts.title: Service accounts
accounts.empty: This project has no service account yet.

keys.noCredential: This account declares no api-key credential; add one to its manifest first.
keys.noStore: API keys need the Portal database, which is not configured here.
keys.newHint: Store it in your secret manager now.
keys.onceWarning: This is the only time the key is shown. It is stored as a hash and cannot be recovered.
keys.rotateHint: Issues a successor; the current key keeps working for 24 hours.
keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke key {keyId}? Callers using it stop working immediately.

matrix.title: Data access
matrix.hint: What you may do through this endpoint, answered by the same policy engine that enforces it.
matrix.noEndpoint: This project publishes no endpoint yet.
matrix.subject: {subject} in space {space}
matrix.empty: No entity type is readable through this endpoint for you.
matrix.forbidden: This endpoint does not answer you; sign in with an account that has a grant.
matrix.unavailable: The access document is not available right now.

flows.title: Flows
flows.subtitle: Pick what you want to set up. The form asks only for what it needs; the platform writes the configuration.
flows.empty: No blueprint is available to you yet.

instantiate.title: Set up {name}
instantiate.hint: Saving proposes a change; it takes effect once the change is approved.

export.title: Download configuration
export.hintProject: Everything project {project} declares, as it is in the repository.
export.hintResource: The manifest of {name}, as it is in the repository.

formats.yamlHelp: One manifest per document, ready to apply again.
formats.jsonHelp: A List object with the same manifests.
formats.zipHelp: Manifests, the files beside them and an index, re-importable as a bundle.

export.noHistory: The history is not available; the current revision is still downloadable.
export.noForge: No repository is configured, so there is nothing to download.
export.secretsNote: Secret values are never part of a download; references to them are.

models.title: LinkML model editor
models.kindHint: Property unless the attribute is a geometry, a link or a language map
models.unitHint: UN/CEFACT common code; exports and dashboards label the values with it
models.slotUriHint: Under the organisation's own prefix; an upstream term is cited, never minted
models.deprecatedKeep: Deprecated (kept, so partner payloads still validate)
models.iriReserved: {iri} is under {namespace}, which belongs to someone else; mint the term under the organisation's own prefix
models.noDiagnostics: The model has no open problems.
models.previewUnavailable: The preview service did not answer; the source is unaffected.
models.exampleUnmapped: The example carries terms the @context does not define: {terms}
models.noChanges: Nothing changed against the version this edit started from.

sdm.subject: Subject
sdm.unavailable: The catalogue is not reachable; import by identifier still works.
sdm.stale: Cached index from {at}; the last refresh did not reach the catalogue.
sdm.pick: Pick a model to see what would be imported.
sdm.previewFailed: The model could not be fetched.
sdm.keepAll: Every upstream slot is kept; unpicked ones are marked deprecated.

apps.title: Applications
apps.subtitle: Apps built for this project. A preview runs against a sandbox space; publishing is a merge request.
apps.empty: This project has no applications yet.

preview.title: Preview of {name}
preview.sandboxSpace: The preview runs against a sandbox space with synthetic data, in a frame that cannot reach the Portal.
preview.notEmbeddable: This app does not allow being framed, so it cannot be previewed here. Set embeddable in its manifest to preview it.

publish.title: Publish {name}
publish.body: Publishing binds the app to the real space and makes it reachable by {visibility}.
publish.hint: This opens a merge request. The app becomes reachable once the change is approved.

generate.title: Generate your own app
generate.subtitle: Describe what you want. The builder agent writes it, tests it and opens a merge request; nothing is deployed without a review.
generate.name: App name

kinds.fullstack: Full stack (Rust backend and React screens)

generate.endpointHint: The app reads this one endpoint and nothing else, so what it may see is what this endpoint publishes.
generate.promptHint: A description, not an instruction the platform obeys: it cannot reach data the list below does not carry.
generate.noBuilder: This deployment has no builder agent, so an app cannot be generated here. The Agent Runner is an optional addon; ask your administrator to install it.
generate.examplesHint: The two apps that ship with the platform are worked examples of the same shape:

examples.hsl-transport: Buses live: 30 vehicles on a map, public and read-only
examples.air-quality: Air quality: stations, a day of history and a steward note

needs.title: What the app will be allowed to read
needs.hint: Derived from what the endpoint publishes. Untick anything the app does not need; nothing can be added here.
needs.audience: The app will be visible to the endpoint's own audience: {audience}.
needs.unavailable: The endpoint does not publish a model yet, so nothing can be derived from it.
needs.none: This endpoint publishes no attributes, so there is nothing for an app to read.

appLifecycle.previewHelp: Bound to a sandbox space and reachable only by the author and reviewers.
appLifecycle.publishedHelp: Bound to the real space and reachable by its audience.
appLifecycle.retiredHelp: Withdrawn; the source stays in the repository.

ckan.title: Open-data catalogue
ckan.intro: An endpoint that declares a publication becomes one dataset in CKAN, with one resource per representation it already serves. The metadata is the endpoint's own DCAT-AP record, so the catalogue and the endpoint cannot disagree.

instances.title: Catalogues
instances.empty: No catalogue is configured for this project yet.
instances.name: Name
instances.tokenHelp: The API token itself is never entered here and never stored in Git: name the secret the operator loaded into the secret store, and the reconciler resolves it at publication time.

publications.title: Published endpoints
publications.empty: No endpoint in this project publishes to a catalogue.

federation.title: Federation
federation.lead: Which sources answer inside this project's spaces, and who this platform is when it forwards a query. A registration grants nothing on its own: the source's own policies still decide what comes back.
federation.empty: No source is registered in this project yet.

dialog.description: A registration names one context space, one target and what that target holds. Name an endpoint on this platform or an address elsewhere, never both.

field.name: Name
field.title: Title
field.spaceHint: The space whose broker learns of the source. The registration is written into this space's tenant and no other.
field.targetHint: One or the other, never both.
field.informationHint: At least one entity selector. A source that claims nothing is matched by nothing.
field.identityHint: Neither mode is a grant: the source's policies apply either way, and the narrower of the two wins.
field.operationsHint: Which operations the source answers for, as NGSI-LD names them (federationOps, retrieveEntity). Left empty means the broker's own default.

identity.serviceAccount: A service account of this platform

mode.exclusive: The only answer for what it covers

card.title: Selected object
card.noCredential: A card shows that a registration authenticates and how. The account it forwards as is resolved when a query is made, and no credential is ever sent to this page.

mappings.unfilled: Required target slots nothing fills: {slots}. Model Tools refuses this mapping (DM-34).
mappings.unchecked: Not evaluated here, they come from native bloblang: {slots}. CI runs them through Bento.
mappings.missing: The input example carries no value for: {slots}.
mappings.laneRaised: {count} native block(s) raise the review lane by one (DM-38).
mappings.exampleNotJson: The example is not valid JSON.
mappings.exampleNotAnObject: The example has to be a JSON object.

syncSources.title: Sync sources
syncSources.intro: A sync source keeps this project aligned with something outside the repository: another Git repository, a published bundle, or another instance's public API. Every run is an import, and every run that changes something opens one merge request.
syncSources.empty: This project syncs from nothing yet.
syncSources.notDurable: This Portal has no database, so a restart forgets where each source stood.
syncSources.detachConfirm: Detach {name}? What it brought in stays; a merge request removes the source itself.
syncSources.detached: A merge request that removes the source is open.
syncSources.proposed: The run opened a merge request.
syncSources.nothingToDo: The run changed nothing: the source has not moved.
syncSources.byWebhook: Runs when the source says so
